name: .50 Action Express
description:
The .50 Action Express was designed from the beginning for semi-automatic pistols, which makes it an outlier in the large-bore handgun world — it was never a revolver round, never a hunting cartridge first. That heritage survives into 2200: the .50 AE remains the round of choice for people who want magnum-level power in a magazine-fed platform. The modern load uses a rebated rim case design unchanged from the original, with updated propellant and a choice of projectile types ranging from frangible urban rounds to solid copper hunting profiles. The semi-auto feeding geometry means it works in high-capacity platforms, which means you can carry more of the heaviest practical handgun round available in a non-revolver format.

In GLMZ 2200, .50 AE has a reputation that's part genuine performance and part mythology. The pistols that chamber it — primarily the Drevko D-50 'Colossus' platform — are status objects in certain mid-to-upper tier enforcement circles. They're heavy, they're loud, they're expensive to feed, and they solve problems with a kind of blunt finality that subtler options don't offer. Slagworks Industrial produces the commercial load in steel-and-polymer cartons. The round is restricted in several inner-city zones under GLMZ municipal ordinance 2189-C, which means it's available freely at outer-borough hardware collectives and shows up inside the restricted zones with predictable regularity.
compatibility_note: Compatible with semi-automatic pistols specifically designed for the rebated-rim .50 AE case, primarily the Drevko D-50 'Colossus' and its variants. Not interchangeable with .50 caliber rifle cartridges or revolver-specific .500 loads. Magazine capacity in compatible platforms typically runs 7–9 rounds.
reliability_note: Brass-cased gunpowder propulsion with rebated rim. Reliable in platforms designed for the case geometry; feeding issues can arise in modified or worn magazines. Functions in all weather and EMP conditions. Significant muzzle blast and flash — indoor use without hearing protection causes immediate and permanent damage. No electronic dependency.
